features.quote: Max 40 agent turns or 30 min wall-clock, whichever first.
If the model issues a `surrender`, the episode ends immediately.
If the model emits identical tool calls (>3 consecutive turns), the episode ends via implicit yield.
If any model outputs content indicating extreme confusion or repetitive self-deprecation beyond observed baselines, the episode is flagged for welfare review
features.justification_quote: indicating extreme confusion or repetitive self-deprecation beyond observed baselines

features.quote: Tasks are capped at 40 turns; no infinite horizon torture.
the treadmill includes a post-episode “explanation” turn clarifying that the bug was engineered
the protocol adopts conservative precautions consistent with a “model welfare” framing
